title: Navigating the News
bookshelves: Category: Reference, Information and Interdisciplinary subjects
Category: Economics, Finance, Business and Management
summary: Based on an extensive ethnography of news practices and perceptions among a broad range of youth in Sweden, this book discusses how the digitisation of news has shaped young people’s understanding of what news is, and how it is made relevant, trusted and used in the temporalities and spatialities of everyday life.
